datasetCounts.title: Fish Specimen Collection of National Museum, Philippines

screeningSignals.marketContextRule: Case-insensitive market/landing/wholesale/fish port/palengke/supermarket terms in locality, waterBody, higherGeography, occurrenceRemarks, eventRemarks, dataset name or recordedBy. Heuristic only.

decision.reason: Two CC0 preserved-specimen records state Manila Bay as the waterbody, carry dates and catalog numbers, and match accepted species names. They are represented only as historical source-reported associations with shared Manila Bay. The broad Metro Manila filter does not assign them to NCR.

heldNamedWaterbodyRows.reason: Occurrence remarks say the preserved specimen was purchased at a Manila fish market.
Locality explicitly says Manila Fish Market; locality does not identify capture water.
Machine observation shares the Manila Bay locality/date/name context with a market-purchased USNM specimen but the relationship and individual identity are not resolved.
Record is identified only to family Cyprinidae.
Record is identified only to genus Auxis.

datasetLevelHolds.reason: All 65 rows have blank locality and the same rounded coordinates; dataset metadata describes collections from landing sites, markets and nearby seas. Dataset-level terms are CC BY 4.0, but locality does not support assigning these rows to Manila Bay.
All localities describe Quezon City Munoz or Cubao farmer's markets; genetic material collection is not evidence of capture waterbody.
All localities describe Manila markets. The dataset is CC BY-NC 4.0 and no market listing is treated as a wild capture locality.

caveats: Both prepared records are historical, with source collection dates in 1963 and 1966.
The record locality and waterBody fields are source claims, not georeferenced catch points.
Manila Bay is shared with NCR, Central Luzon and CALABARZON; the Manila Bay assertions are not assigned to NCR by the stateProvince filter.
The three GBIF issues are retained on every included record; they concern continent and inferred occurrence status, not a positive coordinate.
No current presence, abundance, fishing permission, safety, diet or bait claim is made.
nextStep: Continue the NCR habitat/source denominator and review non-GBIF primary evidence. Do not call NCR baseline-reviewed until shared waters, freshwater reaches, wetlands, waterbody identities and remaining data gaps are reconciled.
